units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 44:18">Targ. Y. Gen. XLIV, 18</cite> addit. (at the end of Gen. in ed. pr., at the end of Ex. in ed. Lsb.) <he>בעט יוסף בעמודא דהיכלא ורַפְּפֵיה</he> Joseph struck with his foot a column of the palace and made it tremble.
Targ. Job IX, 6 מִתְרַפְּפִין (ed. Wil. מִתְרוֹפְפִין, Ithpol.; h. text יתפלצון).
